sasha.sales: Quick ask — NeoRetail demo tomorrow 11:00a PT. They want 3 concurrent demo sessions, roughly 120k tokens/hr total during the 45m window. Can we guarantee capacity or reserve some headroom on a Dedicated pool? Also: what happens to requests when the pool is saturated — do they queue, get rejected, or route to Hosted fallback?

tyler.eng: +1 on needing details. We can do a small reserved pool and an autoscale window. Two Qs: expected concurrency per session and max seq length? helps pick min_gpus.

sasha.sales: each session runs 3 parallel calls, avg seq ~1k tokens, spikes to 2k. So 9 concurrent calls at peak.

maya.sre: We usually set autoscale min_gpus to cover sustained baseline and allow burst credits for spikes. By default our runtime will queue up to `queue.max_concurrent` and then either 429 or route to a fallback policy after `queue.max_wait_ms`. We can set fallback to a hosted model variant if you want graceful degradation.

ben.platform: Putting proposed config here, we can pre-provision and pin a model version for the demo: 
```
pool: demo-neoretail
min_gpus: 1
max_gpus: 6
burst_credits: 1500
queue:
  max_concurrent: 12
  max_wait_ms: 20000
fallback_policy: route_to_hosted
```
This gives headroom for the 9 concurrent calls and some overhead for KV cache.

ops-bot: runbook link created: https://console.redwood.ai/pools/demo-neoretail (provision request 54678) — scheduled allocation window: 2026-08-04T17:30:00Z -> 2026-08-04T19:00:00Z.

sasha.sales: Nice. Two follow-ups: 1) Will routing to hosted change the API key or require client changes? 2) Any cost estimate for the reserved window?

tyler.eng: 1) No client changes — we control routing server-side. Calls will still hit the same API key/endpoint; we switch the model route. 2) Estimate: reservation hourly for min_gpus + expected autoscale average. I can run numbers — baseline estimate ~ $120/hr for min capacity + expected burst usage. I'll post precise breakdown in ~15m.

maya.sre: If you want hard guarantees (no fallback), set `fallback_policy: reject` and increase `min_gpus` so autoscale doesn't kick in. We recommend hosted fallback for demos to avoid 429s. Also ensure API key rate limits are bumped for demo org — ping @sasha.sales if you need that change.

sasha.sales: OK let's keep hosted fallback. Please bump rate limit and send the demo key. Also, can we shorten queue wait to 10s so users see fast failure instead of long hangs?

ben.platform: We can set `queue.max_wait_ms` to 10000 for the pool. Will update config and spin up the pool.

ops-bot: Allocation job started. Provisioning logs: `provision_request_54678 -> pending -> allocating -> started`. ETA node-ready ~ 8m.

maya.sre: Note on observability: enable token-level cost and latency dashboard for the pool and add alert if 5xx rate > 2% or average queue wait > 5s. I'll wire those alerts to #sales-alerts.

sasha.sales: Perfect — thanks everyone. Will share the demo runbook with NeoRetail and ask them to use the provided key. :thumbsup:

ben.platform: Pushed config, pool up. Demo key created and DM'ed to @sasha.sales.

ops-bot: provision_request_54678 -> started -> ready. Pool URL: https://console.redwood.ai/pools/demo-neoretail

sasha.sales: Got the key and runbook. Tagging this as resolved unless anything else pops up. Thanks! :raised_hands:
